title: This Painting Is Eating a Burger 🍔

segments.say: This painting is eating a burger.

segments.text: Every one of these was *one still image.*
segments.say: Every one of these started as one still image.

segments.text: A free AI on GitHub makes it move, on a *6 GB laptop GPU.*
segments.say: A free AI on GitHub makes it move, on a laptop GPU with just six gigabytes.

segments.text: And it doesn't stop at 5 seconds. Wait for *the full minute.*
segments.say: And it doesn't stop at five seconds. Wait for the full minute.

segments.text: How: it's called *FramePack.* Free one-click installer.
segments.say: It's called FramePack. Get the free one-click package, upload a photo, describe the motion, and hit start.

segments.text: *Save this.* Comment the photo you'd bring to life.
segments.say: Save this, and comment the photo you'd bring to life.
